mapper.select: SELECT pd.id, pd.pig_id, pd.ear_no, pd.death_date, pd.death_pig_type, pd.death_kind, pd.death_reason, pd.death_dest, pd.death_weight, pd.oss_ids, pd.operator_id, pd.barn_name, pd.pen_name, pd.create_by, pd.remark, pi.pig_type, pi.pig_sex, pi.pig_breed_code, pi.pig_strain_code, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, pi.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS pig_age, b1.breed_strain_name AS pig_breed_name, b2.breed_strain_name AS pig_strain_name FROM t_farm_pig_death pd LEFT JOIN t_farm_pig_info pi ON pi.id = pd.pig_id AND pi.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_farm_breed_info b1 ON b1.breed_strain_code = pi.pig_breed_code AND b1.breed_strain = '1' AND b1.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_farm_breed_info b2 ON b2.breed_strain_code = pi.pig_strain_code AND b2.breed_strain = '2' AND b2.del_flag = '0' WHERE pd.id = #{id} AND pd.del_flag = '0'
